deploy-bot: Created tag `release/v1.14.0` -> commit `abc123def` for environment: production
Changelog (high level):
- serving: fix KV cache eviction bug that could cause OOM on long contexts
- auth: reduce token refresh latency for batched requests
- console: add per-route p95 latency and token cost breakdown
Full changelog: https://git.redwood.dev/releases/1.14.0
Change window: 16:00-16:30 UTC (30m). Canaries: 5% -> 25% -> 100%.
Pin request: please pin the following routes to `release/v1.14.0` after smoke pass: `/api/generation`, `/api/chat`, `/api/embeddings`.

elena: Thanks — quick Q: can we delay pinning `/api/embeddings` by 1h to run embedding-specific smoke tests? embeddings load different quantized weights so want extra run.

chris: I can own frontend smoke for generation/chat at 16:00. Will watch error dashboards and perf. If anything odd ping me @chris.

raj: Rollback criteria and plan: if 5xx > 1% for 5 continuous minutes on any core route or latency p95 regresses >2x baseline, we trigger rollback. Rollback target: `release/v1.13.7`. Rollback command (ops-run):
```
./deploy/revert.sh release/v1.13.7 production
```
I'll have the revert ready and staged. Also prepping a DB-migration-safe revert checklist.

elena: For pinning ops — use infra pin API: 
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/pin 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $PIN_TOKEN' 
  -d '{"route":"/api/generation","version":"release/v1.14.0"}'
```
I'll run that for generation/chat once smoke passes.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled: 16:00 UTC -> 5% for 5m, then 25% for 10m, then 100%. Will post status updates here at each step. Tag metadata: `release/v1.14.0` (author: elena, sha: abc123def).

leah: :thumbsup:  I'll keep the incident channel on standby and coordinate support.

chris: Noted — I'll add a quick smoke checklist in the release ticket and mark when green.

raj: If we need a fast rollback, I'll coordinate network-level routing rollback + app revert. Expect ~7-10 minutes RTO if manual.

elena: Sound plan. Pin generation/chat at +2m after smoke green, hold embeddings +1h. Will update here when pinned.

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Posting follow-ups in-thread as canary progresses.
